note: Every SECURITY DEFINER function in public must appear here. A function in neither this file nor the database fails supabase/tests/tenancy-definers.test.mjs. The classification is for prioritising Stage 5; the guard only cares that nothing is unclassified.

groups.A: Reads that span rows. Set-returning or aggregating. With no tenant predicate they return every tenant's data to any caller. Fixed last, once the isolation test from Stage 6 exists.
groups.B: Predicates about a row. Each needs 'and is this row in the caller's tenant'.
groups.C: Mutators that act on a row named by an argument. Each already asks whether the caller may; each now also needs whether the row is theirs.
groups.D: Triggers. Each must carry tenant_id through, or it writes rows no policy matches.
groups.E: Predicates about the caller's role. Most-called, so changed first: role becomes a property of a membership.

scopes.all: No filter on the caller at all.
scopes.row: Filtered by an id passed in, which is not checked for ownership.
scopes.caller: Filtered to auth.uid(), so it leaks nothing today.

attended(p_event_id uuid).note: Whether the caller attended an event.

award_credits(p_user uuid, p_amount inte.note: Writes credits to any user id. No ownership check at all.

bos_can_access(p_section text).note: Answers whether the caller has a section. Becomes per-tenant in Stage 7.

bos_can_see_task(p_task uuid).note: The visibility predicate behind the Plan section. Needs a tenant clause.

bos_current_tenant().note: Added in 0034. The tenant the caller is acting in, which every Stage 4 policy compares against. A tenant_id claim in the token wins but is checked against membership first, so a claim naming someone else tenant returns null rather than granting it. Definer for the same reason is_admin is: it is called from inside policies and nesting a policy evaluation in every one of them buys nothing.

bos_dashboard_summary(p_from date, p_to.note: Aggregates tasks, goals, money and events into one jsonb. Every number would span tenants.
Same, with filters that do not include the tenant.

bos_event_slug(p_title text, p_id uuid).note: Scans events to make a slug unique. Should be unique per tenant, not per platform.

bos_govern_attention().note: Set-returning, no caller filter of any kind. Returns every governed record that needs attention. Without a tenant predicate it returns every tenant's.

bos_guard_contact_rate().note: Trigger. Enforces the contact form ceiling.

bos_guard_task_completion().note: Trigger. Blocks completion without an assignee, a comment and approval.

bos_my_sections().note: The nav's source of truth. Becomes per-tenant.

bos_notify_task_decision().note: Trigger. Writes a notification, so it must carry the tenant through.

bos_rate_limit(p_bucket text, p_key text.note: Platform infrastructure. Stays global, but the buckets should carry a tenant so one tenant cannot exhaust another's allowance.

bos_section_status().note: Per-section counts for the nav. Counts would include other tenants' rows.

bos_seed_tenant_membership().note: Added in 0034. Joins a new account to the default tenant, so membership does not rot between now and Stage 7. Temporary: once invitations exist, joining a tenant stops being automatic and this goes away.

bos_set_module_access(p_user uuid, p_sec.note: Grants sections to a user. Must not reach a user outside the caller's tenant.

bos_sop_current(p_sop uuid).note: Resolves a SOP to its live version by id.

bos_sync_roadmap_tasks().note: Rewrites roadmap task links across the table.

bos_sync_task_approval().note: Trigger. Keeps the approvals inbox in step.

bos_task_completion_block(p_task uuid).note: Explains why a task cannot complete. Reveals the task's state to any caller.

bos_tenant_role(p_tenant uuid).note: Added in 0034. The caller role in a tenant. Definer by necessity, not convenience: a policy on tenant_members asking this question by selecting from tenant_members would recurse through its own policy forever, and bypassing RLS inside the helper is what breaks the cycle. Filtered to auth.uid(), so it can answer about nobody else.

bos_track_changes().note: Trigger on six governed tables. Writes govern_changes, which must inherit the row's tenant or the history becomes invisible.

bos_user_directory().note: Returns the whole staff directory. Role-gated, so an employee of tenant B would see tenant A's people.

check_in_ticket(p_code text).note: Admits an admin, the event host, or anyone with the Events section. None of those stops another tenant's admin checking in your attendee.

community_leads(p_community uuid).note: Whether the caller leads a community.

create_pending_order(p_event_id uuid, p_.note: Creates an order against an event id.

ensure_group_seed_post(p_event_id uuid).note: Writes a seed post for an event.

event_attendance(p_event_ids uuid[]).note: Set-returning, keyed by ids with no ownership check on them. Pass another tenant's event ids and it answers.

expire_pending_orders().note: Sweeps every pending order. Run by the daily job, so it should stay global but must not be callable per tenant.

fulfil_order(p_order_id uuid, p_payment_.note: Completes a payment by id. No caller check at all.

get_all_host_earnings().note: Every host's money. The clearest cross-tenant read in the system.

get_directory().note: Set-returning, no filter. Reads the member directory.

get_event_stats(p_event_id uuid).note: Aggregates one event. The event id is not checked for ownership.

get_host_earnings().note: Filtered to auth.uid(), so it leaks nothing today. It still needs scoping once one person hosts in two tenants.

get_organizer(p_id uuid).note: Reads a user profile by id. No ownership check.

get_top_members(p_limit integer).note: Leaderboard across all members. Would mix tenants into one ranking.

handle_new_user().note: Trigger on auth.users. Creates the public.users row, so it decides which tenant a new account joins.

is_admin().note: The most-called function in the system. Becomes a question about a membership, not a user.

is_paid_member().note: Membership tier is per tenant once each business sells its own.

join_waitlist(p_event_id uuid, p_attende.note: Writes a waitlist row against an event id.

member_discount_pct(p_user_id uuid).note: Reads another user's tier by id.

notify(p_user_id uuid, p_type text, p_ti.note: Writes a notification to any user id. Called by the trigger functions in group D.

notify_followers(p_event_id uuid).note: Fans out notifications for an event.

public_stats().note: Deliberately readable by anonymous visitors. Under tenancy it has to become per-tenant, or every tenant's public site shows the platform total.

record_payout(p_host_id uuid, p_amount i.note: Money out, to a host id.

record_sponsorship(p_amount integer, p_n.note: Money in. Writes an unscoped row.

redeem_promo(p_code text).note: Increments a promo by code alone.

refresh_badges(p_user uuid).note: Recomputes badges for a user id.

register_for_event(p_event_id uuid, p_at.note: Public registration path. No caller check by design.

report_content(p_post_id uuid, p_comment.note: Files a report against a post id.

sync_user_email().note: Trigger. Mirrors the auth email onto public.users.

unlock_file(p_file_id uuid).note: Unlocks a gated file by id.

validate_promo(p_code text).note: Looks a promo code up by code alone. Two tenants with the same code collide.
